parts.text: Which grouping uses type of movement and the body parts used?

options.text: Butterfly: flying with wings; snake: crawling with body; kangaroo: hopping with hind legs
Butterfly: flying with legs; snake: hopping with wings; kangaroo: crawling with fins
Butterfly, snake, and kangaroo: all in one water-habitat group

parts.text: Name the type of movement and the body part the kangaroo uses.

stem: Ojas watches a butterfly fly using its wings, a snake crawl using its body, and a kangaroo hop using its hind legs.

teacher.key_rationale: Animals are grouped by movement type and body parts used: wings for flying, body for crawling, hind legs for hopping. Mixing body parts or grouping by habitat misses that hinge.
